title: Meeting Rooms II
description: Given an array of meeting time intervals `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [start_i, end_i]`, return the minimum number of conference rooms required to hold all meetings without overlaps.

examples.explanation: No meetings overlap, so 1 room suffices.

hints: Think about events: when a meeting starts, room count increases; when a meeting ends, room count decreases.
Sort start times and end times independently, or use a min-heap tracking earliest ending meetings.
If the earliest ending meeting ends before or at the start time of the next meeting, reuse the room.
